ruling_text:
Case Number:
25STCV13037
Hearing Date:

March 20, 2026
Dept:

No.
7 – Camila Escobar v. Michael Deitch, et al.
Petition
to Approve Compromise of Claim or Action for Minor Claimant Camila Escobar
Petitioner
Jose Escobar petitions to approve the compromise of this action on behalf of
minor Camila Escobar. The Court cannot approve the minor’s compromise because
the petition has several defects and appears to be missing necessary pages.
First,
while Petitioner seeks to deposit the settlement funds into an insured bank
account, Petitioner did not submit
Order to Deposit Funds in Blocked Account
on Judicial Council MC-355, nor identify the name, branch, and address of
the bank as required under § 18(b)(2).
Second,
Petitioner did not submit a retainer agreement or an attorney declaration to support
the attorney fee request. These documents should be included under §§ 13(a) and
17(a). Also, Petitioner lists $1,000 in attorney fees in § 13(a), but later
lists $5,625 in § 16(c).
Third,
Petitioner claims that the total gross settlement amount is $22,500 but lists
each of the seven Defendants as contributing $4,000 each in § 10(b). This is
inaccurate and should be corrected in the future petition.
Lastly,
Petitioner did not sign the petition.
The
petition to approve compromise of claim or action for minor is
denied
without prejudice.
